question: Where can I find café inside 170 kilometers as I travel from African American Cultural Garden, Cleveland, OH toward Mentor Civic Arena, Mentor, OH?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'cafe' AND ST_Intersects( pois.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%African American Cultural Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cleveland%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Mentor Civic Arena%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Mentor%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%OH%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 170000 -- 170 kilometers in meters ) );
